noiseBarrier.title: The hiring noise barrier
noiseBarrier.studyIndexDescription: That's the average timeframe a human reviewer spends on your profile before decisioning a binary path.
descriptionParagraphs: Standing out doesn't require crazy color swirls or multi-column graphical bars. In fact, complex graphics often confuse the Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) that crawl databases before a human ever looks at them.
What guarantees an interview callback is readability (strict visual hierarchy) combined with metrics-driven contributions.

The LunchResume formula has been coengineered to ensure your file loads cleanly into standard parser frameworks while structuring information to capture immediate attention during that critical six-second window.

manifesto.title: Why is LunchResume 100% free?
paragraphs: Most "free" resume builders lure you in under the guise of zero costs, wait for you to spend 60 minutes typing your entire employment history, and then lock your download behind an unavoidable $19.99 monthly subscription paywall. We think that is exhausting and highly predatory for people actively seeking opportunities.
listItems: No Hidden Credit Cards: You will never be asked for billing details to obtain your documents.
Security by default: Your personal data runs locally directly inside your browser cache. Zero servers storing your contact details.
100% Clean Code files: Produced outcomes are completely standard semantic HTML text blocks, ensuring absolute ATS compatibility.
manifesto.footnote: Supported purely by voluntary tips, community donations, and software developers contributing open-source components during their lunch hours.

items.question: Are these files ATS-friendly?
items.answer: Yes, thoroughly. Most applicant tracking tools crawl raw text nodes. Our templates avoid complex floating graphics and columns that typically corrupt text flows in generic design builders, guaranteeing maximum parsing scores.

items.question: Where is my information stored?
items.answer: Nowhere but your current device browser. We run a fully sandboxed client-side compilation model. Your inputs never touch external clouds, preventing risk of private data scraping or sales.

items.question: How do I download as PDF?
items.answer: Click the PDF Print button on the top-right. Standard print styles configure the page into flawless, high-resolution printable grids. You can choose "Save as PDF" directly in your browser's print dialog!

items.question: Can I write custom sections?
items.answer: You can edit, add, and remove experiences or projects instantaneously. Our flexible fields allow adapting any text slot or tagging specific skills on-the-fly.
